description.en: The ID of the activation code.

descriptions.zh: 如果您担心已创建的激活码存在泄露的风险，可以通过该接口禁用激活码。禁用后无法再通过该激活码注册新的迁移源，但不会影响已经注册的迁移源。
descriptions.en: If you suspect that an activation code is compromised, call this operation to disable it. A disabled activation code cannot be used to register new migration sources. Existing migration sources are not affected.
